note: Snapshot of Tim's public reviews. Google: Business Profile API v4 via GBPOS (rating + count + text). Booksy: rating + count from the public profile's structured data (its recent reviews are star-only). Quotes are verbatim; trimmed only with … or a bracketed [word]. Excluded on purpose: family/related reviewers (Murillo Family, Debbie Murillo), our partner (Colin), and any review naming a competitor or a product brand. No rating schema is emitted (self-serving LocalBusiness ratings are ineligible for Google review snippets). Refresh with tools/reviews-refresh.mjs.

quotes.author: Matt
quotes.text: Always a great cut & beard line up!

quotes.author: William M.
quotes.text: Excellent barber, with professional and precision cuts, which is complimented by great pricing and an environment that makes you feel like you're not in a small town.

quotes.author: Trey K.
quotes.text: Tim takes the time to understand what you’re wanting and then skillfully executes that exact cut with precision and professionalism. I can’t recommend him highly enough.

quotes.author: Jamie D.
quotes.text: Tim has been my barber for years, he always cuts my hair exactly how I ask and does a phenomenal job each time. Tim takes his time and pays attention to detail, always consistent with his appointments and I always recommend people to go to him for their haircuts!

quotes.author: Bethany A.
quotes.text: He takes his time and talks [my kids] through the process to make sure they get what they want. He tries to get to know each client and helps them feel comfortable.

quotes.author: Steven C.
quotes.text: He makes you feel right at home, takes his time, and pays close attention to every detail to make sure you leave with the quality cut and style you’re looking for.

quotes.author: Google reviewer
quotes.text: I get a taper fade down to no guard with a hard part and like most I’m particular about my haircuts. The cuts have always turned out just how I wanted them.

quotes.author: Serg R.
quotes.text: Great cut and man of God. Strongly recommended. I wont go anywhere else.

quotes.author: David T.
quotes.text: Finding a barber who truly listens and nails the details is a rare find, but Tim Murillo at Divinely Faded is exactly that.
